text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 11

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM CERTIFICATE OF URGENCY UNDER ARTICLE 41(1) In exercise of the power conferred by Article 41(1) of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby certifies that there is a case of urgency in respect of the Supply (2020/2021), Bill, 2020. Dated this 8th. day of Rejab, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 3rd. day of March, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM. Dicetak oleh Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
